name: anim_jyu_twist_left
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: Facing the viewer with both hands on his hips, he slowly and lewdly twists his body to his left: the hips swing out to his left and rotate, the belly and chest turn toward his left so his right shoulder comes forward and his left shoulder goes back, the whole torso twisting at the waist like wringing a towel, the knees bending a little, and he holds the twist at the end. His head stays upright and keeps facing straight toward the viewer, looking down with the same heavy smug gaze; only the body below the neck turns. The belly and chest sag and wobble heavily with the twist. Very slow, sticky, syrupy motion. The face keeps exactly the same eyebrows, nose, closed mouth and half-lidded eyes. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
